content.title: The S&P 500 Might Be Overheated, but Bank of America Sees Value in These 2 Stocks
content.summary: For the year-to-date, the S&P 500 has posted a gain of 17% and has been notching record highs. While those gains are fostering an optimistic mood on Wall Street, some voices are counseling caution.
